description: This file defines an AdminLogin React component, which renders an admin login form with username and password fields. It handles user input, manages loading state, and performs a mock login action by invoking a login method from a custom store and navigating to the admin dashboard.

methods.name: onSubmit
methods.description: Handles form submission: prevents default submission, sets loading state, simulates login delay, invokes login method, navigates to dashboard, then resets loading state.

calls: login({ id: 'admin-1', name: 'Portal Admin', role: 'admin', email: `${username}@gov.local` })
